title: Intracellular Calcium Assay
author: Wakana Shoda
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baihicb6

steps.title: Prepare Loading Buffer
steps.instruction: Make Solution A by mixing 5 ml Recording Buffer, 50 µl Probenesid, 80 µl Pluronic F‑127, and add pure water to a final volume of approximately 5–10 ml. Make Solution B by adding 50 µl DMSO and 50 µl Fluo‑4. Combine Solutions A and B and heat the resulting loading buffer to 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Mix 5 ml Recording Buffer, 50 µl Probenesid, 80 µl Pluronic F‑127; add water to ~5–10 ml (Solution A).
Add 50 µl DMSO and 50 µl Fluo‑4 to make Solution B.
Combine Solution A with Solution B.
Heat the combined loading buffer to 37 °C.

steps.title: Load Cells with Buffer
steps.instruction: Wash cultured cells in a glass‑bottom dish with PBS, add 1.2 ml of the pre‑warmed loading buffer, introduce any experimental drugs, and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.2 ml loading buffer to the dish.
Add the required drugs during this period.

steps.title: Prepare Recording Buffer
steps.instruction: While cells are incubating, prepare Recording Buffer by mixing 5 ml Recording Medium, 50 µl Probenesid, and add pure water to reach an approximate total volume of 5–10 ml.

substeps.instruction: Combine 5 ml Recording Medium with 50 µl Probenesid.
Add water to bring the volume to ~5–10 ml.

steps.title: Replace Buffer for Recording
steps.instruction: After the 1‑hour loading incubation, wash the cells with PBS and replace the loading buffer with 1.2 ml of the freshly prepared recording buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.2 ml recording buffer to the dish.

steps.title: Stimulate and Image Calcium
steps.instruction: Apply the desired stimulus (e.g., 10 mM KCl), then quantify Fluo‑4 fluorescence from five regions of interest using an LSM 510 Meta confocal microscope and analyze the data with ZEN 2009 software (Carl Zeiss, Oberkochen, Germany).

substeps.instruction: Add stimulus such as 10 mM KCl.
Acquire fluorescence images of Fluo‑4 from five ROIs with LSM 510 Meta.
